Text:
School is back in session across Shelby County — and for some, it already has been.

Tenaha ISD and Timpson ISD kicked off the 2026–27 school year this week. Joaquin and Shelbyville students head back Monday, August 10. Center ISD opens its doors on Wednesday, August 12.

Whether your kids are Roughriders, Rams, Tigers, Bears, or Dragons — this is the time of year Shelby County feels like itself again. New backpacks, new teachers, new seasons.

Good luck to every student, teacher, coach, and family across all five schools this year. Morrison Insurance has been a neighbor in this community since 1923, and we’re proud to cheer on every school in the county.

Here’s to a great year. 💛

Text:
Fall sports are officially here in Shelby County.

This afternoon, the Center Roughriders host the Shelbyville Dragons in the first volleyball game of the 2026 season — a Shelby County matchup to open the year. Tip-off is at 4:30 PM at Center ISD.

Volleyball doesn’t always get the Friday night spotlight, but these athletes put in the same work, the same early mornings, and the same dedication as any team in the county. Today’s a great reason to show up.

Good luck to both squads. Morrison Insurance is proud to support every team in Shelby County — on the court, on the field, and in the classroom.

#GoRoughriders #GoDragons #ShelbyCountySports #VolleyballTexas #CenterISD #ShelbyvilleISD #DeepEastTexas

Text:
Friday night lights are back in Shelby County.

Tomorrow, the Center Roughriders travel to Pine Tree and the Shelbyville Dragons head to Waskom for the first football games of the 2026 season. Two Shelby County teams, two road tests, one Friday night.

Football season in Deep East Texas is something special. The parking lots fill up early, the concession stands smell like fall, and the whole community shows up. That starts tomorrow.

Good luck to Coach and the Roughriders. Good luck to the Dragons. Shelby County is watching.

Morrison Insurance has been a neighbor here since 1923 — we’ll be cheering right alongside you all season long.
